expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Six days, two cities and one bullet train. It is the cheapest honest way into Japan without cutting the good bits.
expert.tip: Fly into Haneda if you can. The Kamata hotel is one short train from the terminal, which saves a tired first evening.

summary: Six days on a tighter budget: three nights in Tokyo with a shared city tour and a day out to Mount Fuji and Hakone, then the bullet train to Osaka for two nights and a walking tour of the food streets.
included: Included: 5 nights with daily breakfast; Shinkansen bullet train from Tokyo to Osaka; private airport transfers; full day Tokyo city tour by coach; Mount Fuji and Hakone day trip with bullet train return; Osaka half day walking tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
